parent_objective: design no-training fresh/generalization benchmark for raw scaling candidates before integration, PPO, or promotion
blocked_by: raw candidates have public proof-gate retention but no fresh/generalization evidence

public_gates: M899 must design fresh/generalization benchmark only
M899 must include M568, alpha_0_1, raw candidates, heuristic, and random
M899 must pre-register success and termination non-regression
M899 must pre-register clearance effect-size threshold
M899 must keep PPO and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run benchmark in M899
do not train actor or residual parameters
do not treat public proof gates as generalization
do not use private holdout results for tuning

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_generalization_design: design fresh distribution check for raw scaling usefulness
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: converts M898 raw scaling audit into a no-training fresh benchmark design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no benchmark execution, training, PPO, learned driver claim, public-base integration, or promotion
stop_condition: stop if benchmark policies are incomplete
stop if success/termination non-regression is omitted
stop if clearance threshold is not pre-registered
stop if PPO or promotion is admitted
fallback_plan: if design is accepted, execute no-training fresh benchmark next
if scenario sampling risk is high, first run a smoke sampling check
if public overfit risk dominates, route to fresh pair-delta surface refresh
if benchmark policy set is too large, split into alpha/raw comparison and baseline comparison
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M898 routes raw scaling pass to fresh/generalization design

hypothesis: Raw candidates passed public proof gates, so the next safe step is a no-training fresh/generalization benchmark design that tests usefulness without PPO or promotion.
success_criteria: M899 writes a benchmark design document
M899 names all candidate and baseline policies
M899 defines seeds, episodes, config, and run dirs for later execution

M899 keeps benchmark execution, PPO, and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: M899 omits alpha_0_1 or raw comparison
M899 treats fresh benchmark as private holdout
decision_rule: M899 may only design the fresh/generalization benchmark. It must not run benchmark, train, run PPO, or promote.
